name: Steamed rice cakes
summary: Small steamed rice cups, fragrant and chewy, topped with fried bread, pork floss, and scallion fat and finished with sweet-sour fish sauce. Tuy Hòa’s cups are not the bánh bèo of other places.
origin: Tuy Hoa. Du lịch Phú Yên’s 6 October 2024 cẩm nang and its food roundup describe the local cup.
texture: The rice-flour batter is steamed in small cups, so each one is fragrant and chewy.
howToEat: Spoon sweet-sour fish sauce into the hot cup and eat it from the cup. Some cooks top it with pork floss, crisp fried bread, and chives, and you can add bánh hỏi.
where: The foot of Núi Nhạn, on Lê Trung Kiên and Tản Đà.
seoTitle: Banh beo in Tuy Hoa — small cups at the foot of Nui Nhan
seoDescription: Steamed rice cups with fried bread, pork floss, and scallion fat at the foot of Nui Nhan in Tuy Hoa.
